title: api-schema-versioning-deprecations-beta-headers-backcompat-shims
author: Priya Narayanan
release_notes: Introduces API schema v2 with beta header gating, deprecations for legacy streaming envelope, and backward-compatibility shims for OpenAI-compatible clients. See migration notes in docs/api/versioning.md.
body: Summary: This PR introduces API schema v2 changes (structured output normalization, stable function/tool-calling shapes) and a compatibility layer that lets older OpenAI-compatible clients continue to work. It gates breaking changes behind an X-Redwood-API-Beta header and provides runtime shims to translate legacy request/response shapes. Motivation: recent changes to streaming envelopes, structured 'outputs' format, and function calling signatures are necessary for long-term consistency across hosted/dedicated/private deployments but cannot be rolled out abruptly to all customers. This PR proposes: 1) a beta header mechanism (X-Redwood-API-Beta: schema_v2) to opt-in to the new schema, 2) deprecation of the legacy streaming envelope fields (choices[].delta/{content,role}) in favor of a unified outputs[] shape, 3) runtime backcompat shims that map old OpenAI-compatible shapes to the new internal schema when the beta header is not present, and 4) documentation and SDK examples to help customers migrate. Checklist: - [x] Add schema v2 request/response spec and examples - docs/api/versioning.md - [x] Implement beta header gate and request router - src/api/versioning/feature_gate.go - [x] Add backcompat shims for OpenAI-compatible requests - compat/openai_shim.py - [x] Update streaming runtime to emit both legacy and v2 envelopes when gated - src/serving/streaming/stream_emitter.go - [x] Add unit/integration tests for both shapes - tests/api/test_schema_v2.py - [x] Update python/ts SDK examples - redwood-sdk-python/examples/schema_v2_quickstart.py - [x] Add rollout plan and metrics to console dashboard - console/observability/versioning_panel.yaml Key changes (high level): - Feature gate: X-Redwood-API-Beta header is introduced. When set to "schema_v2" the API will return the new v2 schema (outputs[], tool_call metadata in structured form, and stable function-calling locations). When absent, the server will continue to accept legacy OpenAI-compatible shapes and will return legacy-shaped responses via the backcompat shim. - Schema differences: v2 replaces choices[]/message deltas with outputs[] entries that have stable typed envelopes: { "type": "text|tool|structured", "content": { ... }, "metadata": { ... } }. The new shape unifies streaming and final responses so partials and final tokens share the same envelope semantics. - Streaming changes: The streaming emitter was refactored to produce a canonical v2 event stream. Backcompat mode synthesizes the legacy delta messages from the canonical events (preserving token boundaries and roles). This avoids duplicating runtime tokenization logic. - OpenAI-compat shim: compat/openai_shim.py translates incoming parameters (model=..., stop=..., function_call=...) into the internal v2 request, and translates v2 outputs into choices[] + message / delta shapes so existing SDKs and customer proxies keep working. The shim also logs a deprecation notice when it detects legacy shapes in the request. - SDK/docs: Python and TypeScript quickstarts now show how to opt in to the v2 schema via header and demonstrate function/tool-calling with the new structured outputs. Tests & CI: Initial CI run exposed a failing integration test around function call metadata (Jun found a mismatch in the tool_call.location field). Fix applied in second commit to use stable location semantics (tool_call.location -> metadata.tool_invocation.location). Tests now pass. Rollout & migration plan: - Phase 1 (beta): Opt-in via header. Collect telemetry on per-endpoint error rates and differences between shimmed vs native v2 outputs. - Phase 2 (gradual): Announce deprecation of legacy streaming envelope with 90-day notice; promote SDK updates to surface opt-in examples. - Phase 3 (switch): After customer opt-in and telemetry targets met, require schema_v2 and remove shims. Compatibility guarantees: Backcompat shim is intended as a stop-gap (90-180 days). It covers common shapes used by public SDKs and documented OpenAI-compatible parameters. It does NOT guarantee wire-compatibility for private, undocumented behaviors; customers should test with the beta header. Implementation notes: - The shim runs at the API gateway layer to minimize latency impact; heavy translation work is moved off the hot path where possible and memoized for repeated identical requests. - Streaming emitter uses the same token generation hooks internally; the shim re-emits legacy deltas rather than re-tokenizing. - Added a feature flag (feature.api.schema_v2) and a rollout toggle in the console for internal canaries. Backwards-incompatible items called out for deprecation: - choices[].delta.{content,role} envelope - implicit function_call: "auto" heuristic (replaced with explicit function_call field) - untyped streaming patch objects Migration guidance summary: - To opt-in: send header X-Redwood-API-Beta: schema_v2 and update SDKs to parse outputs[] format. - To continue without changes: no header required; shim will provide compatibility for common cases. - For function/tool-calling: migrate to structured tool descriptors (name, schema, invocation metadata) and read metadata.tool_invocation for location/time info. Monitoring: Added observability dashboards that compare shimmed vs native output distributions to catch regressions. See console/observability/versioning_panel.yaml for queries. Known limitations: - Very old client edge cases that relied on undocumented streaming ordering may observe small differences; these are being tracked in SUP-1021. - Shim increases CPU overhead slightly (~3% observed on our internal perf test) but batching amortizes cost. See perf notes in PR commits. Related PRs: redwood-sdk-python#402 (examples), redwood-docs#118 (versioning docs).

d4e5f6a: implement openai compatibility shim and streaming adapter
f7a8b9c: tests for streaming shapes and function-calling; fix location field naming

review_comments: Ethan Cole (reviewer): Please add a migration note about the 'auto' function_call heuristic being removed. Priya: Added migration doc and explicit deprecation text in docs/api/versioning.md
Marisol Vega (reviewer): Concern about CPU overhead on the shim during high QPS. Priya: Measured ~3% overhead in canary; added memoization and moved heavy work off hot path. See perf/canary results.
Jun Park (reviewer): Found mismatch in tool_call location field in initial tests. Priya: Fixed mapping to metadata.tool_invocation.location in commit f7a8b9c and added unit test.
QA (automated): Integration test failed on first CI run due to ordering of streaming events. Fix applied and CI passed on re-run.

notes_for_release_manager: This is a beta-gated change. Release manager should enable feature.api.schema_v2 in internal canary before enabling console rollout toggle. Notify support and publish migration guide 1 week before widening beta access.
